notes: BIRTH DATA LIKELY DUPLICATED FROM HUSBAND (research 2026-07-03): independent sources (Geni, 'James Pine (Pyne), Sr. (1608-1685)') agree it was her husband, James Pyne, who was baptized 4 June 1608 at Woodbury, near Exeter, Devon — not this woman. No record was found anywhere of Edith's own birth date or place; the tree appears to have copied the husband's baptismal record onto the wife's profile. Treat her birth date/place as unknown, not '4 Jun 1608, Exeter, Devon.' Separately, the tree tags her child as 'Captain James Pine\Pyne (Immigrant)' — but published genealogy points to James Pyne Sr. himself (this woman's husband, not her son) as the one who crossed from Woodbury, Devon to Stamford, Connecticut c. 1640, later removing to Hempstead, Long Island; if the tree's 'Captain James Pine' is meant to be this same immigrant generation, the parent/child relationship (son vs. husband) needs reconciling — likely another duplicate-record/generation-shift artifact.
